t: This is the tomb of Joseph Bonomi, in Brompton Cemetery. Bonomi the Younger, who lived from 1796 to 1878, is commemorated here. He was an English sculptor, artist and Egyptologist, and he also worked as a museum curator. He is described as an archaeologist and writer too, so his interests ran wide. The monument stands among the many graves of this Kensington and Chelsea cemetery, and it marks the memory of a man who gave his working life to art and to the study of ancient Egypt.
